name: Masaki Yoshikazu
source:
Masaki Yoshikazu is starting to feel a little awkward with his girlfriend, [url=https://vndb.org/c3134]Kyouya Touko[/url], and that awkwardness has something to do with his little sister, [url=https://vndb.org/c3126]Masaki Akane[/url]. This awkwardness has become a dark spot in his heart which just keeps growing bigger and bigger. The relationship between Yoshikazu, Touko and Akane is heading in an unexpected direction.

[Edited from [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?product_code=43]MangaGamer[/url]]
